server start
skygo artifacts upload source
cp stdout ref.json
stderr 'upload-id: [0-9a-f]{32}'
! exists native-marker
skygo artifacts download --ref ref.json downloaded
stdout '^downloaded\n$'
cmp source/seed.txt downloaded/seed.txt
private-mode downloaded downloaded/seed.txt
# A second transfer cannot overwrite even a private pre-existing destination.
! skygo artifacts download --ref ref.json downloaded
stderr 'destination already exists'
cmp source/seed.txt downloaded/seed.txt
calls ok:BeginArtifactUpload 1
calls ok:FinalizeArtifactUpload 1
calls BeginArtifactDownload 1
calls CloseArtifactDownload 1
calls SubmitWorkspaceJob 0
calls SubmitJob 0
# Original24h/DeleteAfter and post-last-release grace apply to explicit Remove.
# Refusal must preserve the complete object and its current read authority.
! skygo artifacts remove --ref ref.json --yes
stderr 'failed_precondition|conflict|held'
skygo artifacts download --ref ref.json held-readable
cmp source/seed.txt held-readable/seed.txt
calls RemoveArtifact 1
calls BeginArtifactDownload 2
calls CloseArtifactDownload 2
server stop
! stderr .
-- source/seed.txt --
seed
